references.purpose: directional equipment-board layout only; rejected as innkeeper equipment

prompt: Create a modular INNKEEPER equipment board: one oversized dark-pewter tankard with a thick readable handle, broad rim, two brass bands, and a folded cream polishing cloth wrapped partly around the body. It must remain unmistakable beside a 35x46 actor. Four large, generously separated directional views: front/down, rear/up, left side, right side; one consistent tool identity, handle side, scale, and cloth placement. Compact painterly pixel-art source material with crisp bold clusters, warm upper-left light, dark edge contrast, classic strategy-game readability. Perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background. No person, hands, garment, tray, barrel, counter, cargo, liquid, foam, scenery, text, labels, border, floor, shadow, UI, watermark, duplicate fragments, or extra objects.
